professionalSummary.text: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.

professionalSummary.text: Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting
professionalSummary.witness: Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.

professionalSummary.text: Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year
professionalSummary.witness: Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.

professionalSummary.text: Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts
professionalSummary.witness: Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.

professionalSummary.text: Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited
professionalSummary.witness: Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: a year of the incident register filtered to capacity-related incidents (with the baseline and the rebalancing plan marked) and one cycle's assumptions note; export identifiers are included for tracing

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on the per-customer load model, turning forecasts into plans, incident reduction, taking changes through meetings, and keeping assumptions notes. The materials do not establish the candidate's ownership of the model, the platform team's agreement on plans, or the candidate's role in incident reduction beyond the stated counts.

evidence.text: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.
evidence.notes: The candidate kept the model and recalibrated it monthly.

evidence.text: Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.
evidence.notes: The candidate turned forecasts into plans with the platform team.

evidence.text: Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.
evidence.notes: Incident counts are reported against the baseline.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former platform lead: the incident counts are from the platform incident register, the shard rebalancing plan was the candidate's proposal, and the employment dates match.
evidence.notes: Reference confirms incident counts and candidate's proposal.

evidence.text: Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.
evidence.notes: The candidate took changes through meetings with teams.

evidence.text: Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.
evidence.notes: The candidate kept assumptions notes per cycle.

evidence.text: Work sample: a year of the incident register filtered to capacity-related incidents (with the baseline and the rebalancing plan marked) and one cycle's assumptions note; export identifiers are included for tracing.
